content.title: Air Force Major MAJ 04 Rank
content.text: Approved by The U.S. Institute of Heraldry Official Issue and Approved for wear 3 officially compliant Air Force rank insignia options High-quality 100% USA Made The Air Force Major MAJ O4 Rank marks the beginning of the Field Grade Officer tier within the United States Air Force. Ranking above Captain (O3) and below Lieutenant Colonel (O5), Majors serve as vital leaders and experienced advisors in their units. They often function as main staff officers for brigades or executive officers for task forces, providing direction, strategy, and operational oversight. Our Air Force Major insignia is regulation-compliant and precision-crafted to meet official U.S. Air Force standards. Whether for duty wear, replacement, or collection, each piece reflects the professionalism and authority associated with the Major rank. Proudly Made in the USA. B303AF – Air Force Major MAJ O4 Full Color Chevron Metal Rank. The Air Force Major Full Color Metal Rank features the signature gold oak leaf insignia, symbolizing wisdom and leadership. As the lowest Field Officer rank, Majors play a key role in command and strategic planning. This uniform-ready insignia is crafted from durable metal, sold in pairs, and Made in the USA—ideal for official wear or display. B303BMAF - The Air Force Major Officer MAJ O-4 Subdued Brown Metal Rank is the official issue insignia worn by U.S. Air Force Majors. Representing the first Field Grade Officer rank, the Major serves as a key staff officer at the squadron and group levels, providing critical leadership and operational oversight. This insignia features a subdued brown metal finish designed for low-visibility wear on operational uniforms. The rank displays the gold oak leaf, symbolizing achievement, leadership, and dedication to mission success. P1648 – Air Force Major MAJ O4 OCP Patch With Hook and Loop. This Air Force Major OCP rank patch displays a single oak leaf in brown spice stitching on an OCP/Scorpion camouflage background. Measuring 2" x 2", this patch includes hook and loop backing for secure and easy attachment. Approved for wear with OCP/Scorpion uniforms, this patch represents the professionalism of Field Grade Officers. 100% made in the USA. Copyright © 2026 Medals of America. All rights reserved.
